allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5001/health" -TimeoutSec 3 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output "HEALTH: $\($r.StatusCode\) $\($r.Content\)" } catch { Write-Output "HEALTH-ERR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" }; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5001/api/products" -TimeoutSec 3 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output \("PRODUCTS: " + $r.StatusCode + " len=" + $r.Content.Length\); Write-Output $r.Content.Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(800,$r.Content.Length\)\) } catch { Write-Output "PRODUCTS-ERR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" }; Write-Output "---PORT---"; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5001 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,State,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String)

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== Node processes ==="; Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id,ProcessName,StartTime,@{N='CmdLine';E={\(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$\($_.Id\)"\).CommandLine}} | Format-List | Out-String; Write-Output "=== Listening ports \(Node-owned\) ==="; $nodePids = \(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Id; if \($nodePids\) { Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Where-Object { $nodePids -contains $_.OwningProcess } | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String } else { Write-Output "No node processes" }; Write-Output "=== Anything on 3000/5000/5001/8000/8080 ==="; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { 3000,5000,5001,8000,8080 -contains $_.LocalPort } | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String)

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5001/api/products" -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output "STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; Write-Output \("LEN: " + $r.Content.Length\); Write-Output $r.Content.Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(1500,$r.Content.Length\)\) } catch { Write-Output "ERR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== Hit /api/products from browser-like origin ==="; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5001/api/products" -Headers @{Origin="http://localhost:3000"} -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output \("STATUS: " + $r.StatusCode\); Write-Output \("CORS: " + $r.Headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"]\) } catch { Write-Output \("ERR: " + $_.Exception.Message\); if \($_.Exception.Response\) { Write-Output \("STATUS: " + [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode\) } }; Write-Output "=== Spam 6 requests to test rate limit ==="; 1..6 | ForEach-Object { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5001/api/products" -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output \("#$_ : " + $r.StatusCode\) } catch { Write-Output \("#$_ ERR: " + [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode + " " + $_.Exception.Message\) } })

PowerShell($conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \(-not $conns\) { Write-Output "Nothing listening on 5001" } else { $conns | ForEach-Object { $procPid = $_.OwningProcess; $p = Get-Process -Id $procPid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $cmd = \(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$procPid"\).CommandLine; Write-Output \("PID=$procPid  Name=$\($p.ProcessName\)  Cmd=$cmd"\) } })
